system.description:
Two heads in permanent conflict. Madness, the deep ocean, and the terror at the bottom of the dark.

  • Dark Gift (1st): For 1 Patron Favour, one creature within 60ft that can see you makes a Will save against your Class Save DC or is Terrified until the end of its next turn; on a natural 1 it is Stunned as well.
  • Patron's Mark (4th): For 1 Patron Favour, hold eye contact with one creature within 30ft: it makes a Will save against your Class Save DC or spends its next action doing something erratic and harmless that the GM chooses.
  • Patron Feature (8th): For 1 Patron Favour, each enemy within 30ft makes a Will save against your Class Save DC. For each that fails, the GM rolls 1d6: 1 to 2 it attacks the nearest creature, 3 to 4 it drops what it holds and flees, 5 to 6 it loses its next action.

Allegiance: Chaotic Evil, the patron's alignment. Lore: Demogorgon in the World of Arneyan wiki.
